name: Varying Refinement Levels of Coarse Elements
aliases: Inserting refinement levels into coarse mesh
definition: An optimization strategy where elements from different refinement levels of the refinement tree are inserted into the coarse mesh, affecting macrocell size and BVH efficiency.
summary: Varying Refinement Levels of Coarse Elements optimizes hierarchical volume rendering by selecting specific refinement levels to build the coarse mesh, balancing BVH efficiency against traversal overhead.
